newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil stevedores to resume talks on port dispute.
newsitem.headline: Brazil stevedores to resume talks on port dispute.

text.p: Stevedores at Brazil's key port of Santos and local steel firm Cosipa are this afternoon to resume negotiations over a labor dispute which has already led to two strikes, officials said.

Stevedores have been working over the past few days on a proposal which they will present to Cosipa at a meeting scheduled to begin at 1400 local/1700 GMT, said Antonio Pinho, second secretary of the Santos Stevedores' Union.
Stevedores are protesting against a decision by Cosipa to use its own workers to load and unload vessels at its private terminal in Santos.
They have already said they may consider further strikes should the current talks fail but for the time being, nothing is planned, Pinho said.

A second session of talks has already been scheduled for Tuesday afternoon and union workers will wait to see the progress of the negotiations before discussing whether there is a need to take any action, he added.
